purpose: Teach: 持ち込む/値引き/コツコツ/売店/上層/掛かり/精算/夜勤

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本気で、絶対、新製品、絶対、持ち込む、絶対、商談、絶対、進めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I need us to bring a new product to market with absolute seriousness. Get it in front of customers, move the deal forward. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Clipped, commanding tone. Sharp attack on each key point. No hesitation. The weight of someone used to being obeyed sitting behind every word.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様、本気で、絶対、値引き、絶対、ご要望、絶対、検討中です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're genuinely considering the customer's request for a discount. I appreciate your trust in us.
lines.style: Steady, measured acknowledgment. Respectful without being deferential. Even cadence — showing he's heard the priority and is taking it seriously.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員、本気で、絶対、コツコツ、絶対、努力、絶対、評価しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: And make sure we're recognizing the effort our people put in. Steady work deserves real acknowledgment.
lines.style: Firm but not unkind. A slight soften from the previous line — he's being clear about values now, not just orders. Deliberate pace.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内、本気で、絶対、売店、絶対、リニューアル、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're moving forward with the renewal of our in-house kiosk. The team's commitment to this has been genuine.
lines.style: Calm, professional update. Matching his shift in tone — showing alignment with his values. Not rushed, not padded. Just clear.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本気で、絶対、上層、絶対、部、絶対、合意、絶対、取れ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: And get agreement from upper management on this. Don't bring me excuses. Bring me consensus.
lines.style: Direct, almost clipped. The return to command mode. Light edge of impatience — he's testing whether Kenji heard the seriousness underneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、掛かり、絶対、長の、絶対、報告、絶対、いただいております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. Our section chief has already reported in. We're coordinated and moving as one.
lines.style: Crisp confirmation. Slightly quicker than before — showing he anticipated this and has already positioned himself. Small note of quiet confidence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お客様、本気で、絶対、精算、絶対、スムーズに、絶対、進めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: And customer checkout has to be smooth. No friction. Make it frictionless.
lines.style: Quiet emphasis on the last three words. Not shouting — the opposite. Calm precision. Like he's carving an instruction into marble.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、本気で、絶対、夜勤、絶対、ローテーション、絶対、整えております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We've arranged the night-shift rotation to support that. Everything's in place.
lines.style: Quieter closing note. Not tentative — confident but understated. The feeling of saying 'done' without the word. Small pause before speaking, then steady delivery.
